t: This is the statue of George Livesey in Camberwell. It shows Livesey, a engineer, industrialist and philanthropist who chaired the South Metropolitan Gas Company, inheriting the business from his father. A blue plaque describes him as one of Southwark's greatest industrialists. The statue was made by Frederick William Pomeroy, a leading sculptor of the New Sculpture movement, which turned towards naturalism. Pomeroy also made the figure of Lady Justice on the dome of the Old Bailey, so his work is well known across London.
